description: baseline

add dke_per_mile = (v_next^2 - v_prev^2)/miles from neighbour link speeds
add v_in (entry speed from the previous link)

raise max_leaf_nodes 31 -> 255
add dke_in_link, the entry-half of the kinetic-energy change ((v^2 - v_in^2)/miles)
add gap_seconds, the idle time between the previous link ending and this one starting
add prev_miles, the length of the previous link
add next_miles, the length of the next link
add next_gap_seconds, the idle time after the link
raise max_iter 300 -> 2000
raise max_iter 2000 -> 8000
add prev2_speed, the speed two links back
add dv_out, the exit speed change on a raw scale rather than per mile

add journey_rate, a leave-one-out shrunk mean of the journey's training-link rates

estimate the journey effect from the model's training residuals as a post-hoc additive offset, replacing the two journey mean-rate features
add the residual journey offset on top of the journey mean-rate features (rather than instead of them)
estimate the journey offset from 2-fold out-of-fold residuals instead of in-sample ones
add dke_out_link, the exit half of the kinetic-energy change
fit least squares on the physics terms (grade, dke, speed) first and boost the trees on its residual
average an ensemble of 5 boosted models, each seeing a random 70% of the features at every split
score the out-of-fold residual with a single model instead of the whole ensemble, to buy back runtime
average the journey residual over distance instead of over links (total residual energy / total residual miles)
raise the journey-offset shrinkage from 20 to 40 links
lower the ensemble feature subsample from 0.7 to 0.5
drop the journey_gge_per_mile feature now that the post-hoc offset is itself distance-weighted
blend in a dilated-CNN sequence member at weight 0.25, trained on the leftover budget
move three ensemble members from the out-of-fold pass to the final one (5/5 -> 3 out-of-fold, 8 final)
raise the sequence blend weight from 0.25 to 0.32
raise the journey-offset shrinkage from 20 to 30 links
narrow the sequence member from 128 to 96 channels
narrow the sequence member from 96 to 64 channels
drop the dilation-8 block, shrinking the sequence receptive field from +/-30 links to +/-14
drop the dilation-4 block too, shrinking the sequence receptive field from +/-14 links to +/-6
drop the dilation-2 block as well, shrinking the sequence receptive field from +/-6 links to +/-2
widen the now two-block sequence member from 64 back to 128 channels
re-test the blend weight at 0.30 now that the sequence member is smaller and better
raise the blend weight from 0.30 to 0.35
